review_candidates.title: 资深研究员（博士/博后）西宁北京两地
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 研究方向及内容 研究方向1：通过离子掺杂、表面包覆和形貌调控等手段，提升钴酸锂能量密度和高电压下的结构稳定性。 研究内容1： 材料制备：采用固相法、共沉淀法等不同方法合成改性高电压钴酸锂，并研究制备工艺对材料结构和性能的影响。 性能测试：在不同温度和电压下测试改性钴酸锂的电化学性能，包括可逆容量、循环稳定性、倍率性能等。 机理研究：通过原位测试、电化学阻抗谱、透射电镜等手段，研究高电压钴酸锂在充放电过程中的相变机制和界面演化过程。 应用研究：将改性高电压钴酸锂应用于实际产线进行批量制备，评估其量产可行性。 研究方向2：通过离子掺杂、包覆层优化、形貌和结构调控等手段，提升磷酸铁锂材料压实密度和能量密度。 研究内容2： 材料制备：采用液相法、水热法、固相法等不同方法合成高纯度、高压实密度的磷酸铁锂。 性能优化：通过碳包覆层和压实工艺优化等手段提高磷酸铁锂的压实密度和能量密度，并评估其对电化学性能的影响。 机理研究：通过原位测试、拉曼光谱、透射电镜等手段，表征磷酸铁锂的晶体结构和微观形貌，研究其与电化学性能的关系。 应用研究：将高能量和高压实密度磷酸铁锂应用于实际产线进行批量制备，评估其量产可行性。 相关方向博士应届生也可

review_candidates.title: Electrical Project Engineer
review_candidates.description: He whakahaere aronga-anamata a Mercury, e tuku ana i te pūngao me ngā whitimamao ki te mahi a tangata o Aotearoa, ā, he nui ake i tā ētahi atu. Waihoki, e para ana i te huarahi mā te pūngao whakahou me te whai i tētahi anamata toitū. Kei te iho ko tō mātou koronga. Tiakina te anamata, mā te tūhono i ngā tāngata me ngā wāhi o te inamata. He āki tēnei i a tātou ki te whakapau kaha kia hua ake ai he anamata pai ake mō ō tātou tāngata, mō ō tātou hapori, me Aotearoa. Mercury is a bold future-focused organisation, providing energy and telecommunications to more Kiwis than anyone else, leading the way with renewable energy and working toward a sustainable future. At the heart is our purpose. Taking care of tomorrow: connecting people and place today. This pushes us to do all we can to create a better future for our people, our communities, and Aotearoa New Zealand. Tā mātou arawātea | Our Opportunity: Join Mercury's $1B investment in powering New Zealand's energy future! Are you ready to help shape the future of electricity in Aotearoa? Mercury is seeking an Electrical Engineer to support the delivery of electrical workstreams across our hydro and geothermal generation projects. This is a unique opportunity to work on some of New Zealand's oldest and most iconic energy assets, helping to maintain, upgrade, and modernise critical infrastructure that supports a sustainable energy future. Working alongside experienced engineers, project managers, operational teams, and specialist contractors, you'll contribute across all stages of the project lifecycle, from concept and design through to installation, commissioning, and close-out. You'll help solve complex technical challenges, support engineering decision-making, and ensure safe, reliable, and high-quality outcomes for our generation assets. We offer flexibility in our hours to accommodate your lifestyle. You can work from our office, one of our sites, or from home, while still valuing the opportunities to collaborate with your wider team. This role can be based in Hamilton or Rotorua , close to our hydro and geothermal sites. Key responsibilities include: Technical Delivery: Support the delivery of electrical engineering work across capital and asset improvement projects, ensuring solutions are safe, practical, and fit for purpose. Collaboration & Relationships: Build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders, site teams, contractors, and engineering partners to support successful project outcomes. Project Support: Contribute to project planning, design reviews, commissioning activities, and technical assurance throughout the project lifecycle. Engineering & Quality: Prepare and review engineering documentation, specifications, and technical assessments while supporting compliance with standards and quality requirements. Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve processes, share lessons learned, and contribute to the ongoing development of Mercury's engineering capability. Tāu ka kawe mai | What you'll bring: Degree or higher diploma in Electrical Engineering. Professional membership (e.g. Engineering New Zealand) desirable, but not essential. 4-7+ years' experience in electrical engineering, project engineering, asset management, or capital projects within utilities, energy, industrial, or related sectors. A solid understanding of electrical power systems, equipment, and engineering design principles. Experience working within multidisciplinary project teams and contributing to successful engineering outcomes. Strong communication and relationship-building skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to manage competing priorities and work across multiple projects simultaneously. Well-developed problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyse issues and develop practical solutions. Experience working within structured project delivery or stage-gate frameworks is advantageous. Knowledge of power generation, high-voltage systems, hydro, or geothermal assets would be beneficial but is not essential. Tā mātou e tuku nei | We offer: Additional 5 days leave per annum (MyDays) $400 one-off tax-free payment towards setting up your home office A diverse workplace where your unique abilities and talents will be recognised and encouraged Annual salary reviews with an excellent parental leave policy, plus the option to purchase additional leave The opportunities, career pathways, and facilities associated with working for one of New Zealand's largest multi-utility providers Flexible working policy, with the autonomy and trust to work from our purpose-built premises and from home Discounted health insurance and free life and income insurance Excellent wellbeing programme, including up to $100 annual health checks and a confidential assistance programme Gender affirmation leave and supportive bereavement leave to be taken when you lose anyone close to you, including your pet Mercury is a learning organisation committed to helping our people grow and develop. You'll have access to a range of development opportunities and be encouraged to build both your technical expertise and professional capability. We believe this creates an energised, innovative, and agile environment where our people can do their best work and build rewarding careers. E koekoe te tūī, e ketekete te kākā, e kūkū te kererū Every voice has its place - and together, we thrive. At Mercury, we believe that having a team of individuals with different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives working together makes us stronger. We know some candidates only apply when they meet every requirement. If you're excited about this opportunity and believe your skills and experience are a good match, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every criterion. Please click 'Apply' to submit your application. If you require accessibility or assistance support during the application and selection process, please contact recruitment@mercury.co.nz . Please do not apply via this email address. A full position description is available below. Applications close Wednesday, 23rd September at 5:00pm . Please note that Mercury reserves the right to progress particularly strong candidates through the recruitment process before the closing date. Please apply via this link: Project Engineer – Electrical - Careers at Mercury
